title: tab/popup
description: Engine-to-shell notification: the page opened a window (window.open, a link with target=_blank, a form posting to a new window) and the engine made it a windowless tab of its own (CefLifeSpanHandler::OnBeforePopup), so popups become tabs and never windows. Its first region came before this message (tab/resized names the new tab), and tab/frame and tab/state follow for it as for any tab. `window.opener` works: the popup is the page's own, not a new navigation.

tab.description: The new tab's id (the engine's ids are shared by tabs it was asked to create and popups).

opener.description: The tab whose page opened it.

url.description: The url the popup loads (may be empty or about:blank for a window the opener writes into).

disposition.description: How the page asked for it (CEF's WindowOpenDisposition): a new foreground or background tab, a popup window, or a new window.

userGesture.description: The page opened it in answer to the person's (or an agent's) click or key.
